raw.query: SELECT resolution, MIN(wape) AS best_wape, MAX(wape) AS worst_wape, (MAX(wape)-MIN(wape))/MIN(wape)*100 AS spread_pct, MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE family='fm') AS best_fm_wape, MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE family='fm') AS worst_fm_wape, (MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE family='fm')-MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE family='fm'))/MIN(wape) FILTER (WHERE family='fm')*100 AS fm_spread_pct FROM provenance.forecast_eval WHERE is_valid=true AND signal='images' AND horizon_h=1 GROUP BY resolution ORDER BY resolution
raw.observed: Across all predictors, WAPE spans 0.6374-0.9917 at 15s (55.59% spread) and 0.5153-0.6180 at 1min (19.93% spread). Foundation-model-only spreads are 4.71% at 15s and 1.11% at 1min.
raw.claimed: Inter-model margins are small enough that engineering considerations can drive the choice
raw.evidence: The unqualified all-predictor spread reaches 55.59% at 15s, showing margins are not universally small; they cluster tightly (<=4.71% spread) only within the foundation-model subset.
raw.fix: Qualify the claim: "Among evaluated foundation models, WAPE margins are small enough that engineering considerations can drive model choice."
